canvas.cropModel: Players cover-fit the 1080x1920 canvas, so narrower screens crop it horizontally: crop_per_side = (1080 - 1920 * screenAR) / 2. Measured 48px on a full-bleed iPhone and 28px on Android; worst case for a full-bleed 20:9 screen is 108px. UI icons sit against the physical screen edge, so on cropped devices they intrude further into canvas coordinates - hence 110px horizontal margin everywhere.
canvas.zoneModel: Two stacked rects forming an L: the upper one only pays the crop margin on the right, the lower one also clears the right-hand icon column (crop 110 + icon column ~110 = 220).

overlay.label: Safe Zone
overlay.note: Single universal overlay. Derived from the Instagram Reels measurements (header ends at canvas y=240, username/caption start at y~1749, icon column starts at y~1200), which is the tightest of the vertical platforms - TikTok, Shorts, VK Clips and Likee all fit inside it.
